summary: One thorough gathering round achieved a good-faith counter-evidence attempt for all 5 target claims from counter-evidence-plan.md, so further rounds were not needed. (1) NVIDIA SLM thesis: no independent empirical rebuttal found even on NVIDIA's own paper-correspondence page (only a conceptual counterpoint); indirect evidentiary undermining found via the brief's own SWE-bench Pro/SWE-EVO sources (capability gaps grow with task realism regardless of model tier) and a 2026 small-multi-agent paper showing gains are orchestrator-driven, not sub-agent-scale-driven -- low-confidence counter-claim, largely a 'no rebuttal exists yet' finding as anticipated by the plan. (2) 350M ToolBench result: strong methodological counter-evidence found -- StableToolBench (peer-reviewed-track, 2024) documents the exact ToolEval evaluator/API setup underlying the claim's baselines is unreliable (65% evaluator accuracy, only 44.4% of APIs functionally callable, up to 40% reproduction decline), undermining the evidentiary basis without directly re-testing the 350M model itself. (3) Devstral SOTA claim: found that the 'SOTA' framing was quickly superseded by competing vendor-reported figures (Devstral 2, Qwen3-Coder-Next, DeepSeek-V3.2), directly contradicting durability of the claim, though all competing figures share the same vendor-self-report weakness the brief already flags; Devstral is also absent from Scale AI's independently-run SWE-bench Pro leaderboard. (4) Self-verification contradiction: reconciliation-oriented mechanistic account found (ACL Findings 2024 'Small Language Models Need Strong Verifiers' plus foundational ICLR 2024 Huang et al. self-correction critique), supporting the brief's own trained-verifier-vs-free-form-critique hypothesis rather than picking a side, per the plan's stated success criteria for this claim. (5) RAG oracle caveat: a real-production (WeChat) RAG-for-code-completion study found a retrieval-quality threshold effect where non-oracle RAG can actively harm code generation via context pollution, directly undermining the brief's oracle-caveat-adjacent synthesis; a more general RAG-robustness paper showed milder (2-6%) degradation under realistic noise, included to avoid overstating the case. All five target claims now have either genuine counter-evidence or an explicit, well-searched absence-of-rebuttal finding, satisfying the plan's success criteria without needing rounds 2 or 3.
